page.layout: One printed page, a grammar table of Greek verb forms in two columns of paragraph-style lines under a running head and headings. Page number top left. Running head top right. No marginal notes; the faint text at the right edge is show-through from the facing page and is left out.
page.notes: Greek forms are transcribed from a small, faded print; several accents and breathings are uncertain and may be misread. The running head is taken from the title printed at the top right. The lines are kept as the table's rows, with the left and right column entries run together where the scan does not separate them clearly.
